name: Harissa
siboNotes: Small amounts (1 tablespoon) are generally well-tolerated, but garlic content may trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check ingredient list - some brands add onion powder or garlic powder
Make homemade version using garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Start with small amounts to test tolerance
Store opened paste in refrigerator for up to 6 months
alternatives: Chili flakes with paprika and cumin
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C from red peppers
Good source of vitamin A and antioxidants
Provides small amounts of iron and potassium
